Res.Caption: Document Type
Res.FullDescription: 3-letter Document Type code. This must be unique within the Form Type.

Res.Caption: Force User to Read
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether eDocs of this Document Type are Published by default. This functionality will be used in future.

Res.Caption: Active
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this Document Type can be used in other areas of CargoWise.

Res.Caption: Published
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether eDocs of this Document Type are Published by default.

Res.Caption: Publish Status Updatable
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether individual eDocs can override the Published flag.

Res.Caption: System Defined
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this Document Type is a System type. You cannot edit System Document Types.

Res.Caption: Save copies on eDocs tab
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether copies of printed, faxed or emailed Documents categorized in this Document Type are saved on the eDocs tab.

Res.Caption: Category
Res.FullDescription: The Category this Document Type applies to (e.g. Client/Supplier/Relationship, Accounting, etc.).

Res.Caption: Save Versions
Res.FullDescription: Normally, any System Generated eDocs will be overwritten when a new version of the eDoc is created. However, if the Save Versions flag is ticked for this Document Type, each new version of the eDoc will be saved as a new eDoc rather than overwriting the old one.

Res.Caption: Document Event
Res.FullDescription: Specifies the event code to be added to the relevant job when a document using this Document Type is either delivered (not in draft), or imported using DocManager.

Res.Caption: Parse Type
Res.FullDescription: Defines how the document will be processed when it is sent for parsing.

Res.Caption: Allow Multiple Periodic Docs
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether multiple document tracking records are allowed for periodic documents.

Res.Caption: Company Specific
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this document type is company specific by default.

Res.Caption: Branch Specific
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this document type is branch specific by default.

Res.Caption: Department Specific
Res.FullDescription: Indicates whether this document type is department specific by default.
